title: GPT-6.1 Sol: Pricing, Performance, and How to Route Requests
summary: GPT-6.1 Sol provides logic-heavy processing for enterprise systems. You can determine if this model improves your current automated workflows.
body_markdown:
## Why gpt-6.1 sol improves automation workflows


A stable logical anchor for complex sequences is provided by GPT-6.1 Sol. This ensures that the final output of a ten-step chain remains grounded in your initial constraints.


When an automation fails, you usually have to debug "logic drift," where a model loses the thread of a multi-step instruction mid-execution.


Internal consistency across long-horizon tasks is maintained by prioritizing reasoning depth over raw generation speed. This consistency means fewer manual interventions for edge cases.


### Reduced logic drift in long sequences


The ability to sustain complex reasoning at a fraction of the cost required by flagship frontier models is the primary advantage of GPT-6.1 Sol.


According to performance benchmarks from[Vibe Coding](https://vibecoding.tech/news/2026/09/29/gpt-6-1-sol-price) ,


Higher stability is indicated by a lower score in this context. Because Sol's cost per task is roughly one-fifth of Astra's, you can chain several sequential API calls at a lower cost., you can chain five sequential API calls without the final output deviating from your original schema.


### How gpt-6.1 sol handles structured JSON outputs


The model's ability to transform unstructured noise into predictable data formats is what reliable automation depends on.


This capability is best demonstrated when a central GPT-6.1 Sol node receives a messy, multi-threaded email chain and outputs a clean, structured JSON object with distinct 'intent', 'priority', and 'next_action' fields, so developers can automate complex workflows without manual data parsing.


Secondary "clean-up" prompts are eliminated by enforcing this structure at the inference level. This can affect both the latency and the total token spend per execution.


This structured reliability ensures that the following steps in your workflow receive valid inputs every time, preventing the entire automation from crashing due to a stray comma or a missing bracket in the response.
